**Stable ID:** `DATA-08.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 08 Evaluation integrity and comparability

Define when two reported scores are comparable: same version, split, metric, prompt, harness and aggregation.

## Deliverables

- Comparability criteria checklist
- Non-comparable display rules for consumers

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/RESEARCH_METHOD.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Criteria cite evaluation-methodology literature

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A comparison requires matching version, split, metric and harness
- [ ] Non-comparable scores are labeled, never ranked together
- [ ] Consumers receive the rule as a handoff

## Non-goals

- Producing leaderboards
